title: Curve-driven modular instancing
summary: Create deterministic point instances or swept geometry along validated curves while separating corners, variants, preview, and engine output.

use_when: a curve or path drives repeated modules or cables
avoid_when: the task is unconstrained surface scattering
the result is a unique sculpted mesh

inputs: validated curves with direction, units, closure, and corner policy
module metadata with dimensions, pivots, variants, and optional engine paths
outputs: instance points with finite transforms and valid paths
acceptance: stable seed and repeatable instance count
rollback: one graph Undo group when supported
remove only the newly created namespaced network
